quality_assessment: Excellent chapter with accurate documentation and comprehensive examples. All utility modes are correctly documented and aligned with implementation.
positive_aspects: Accurate documentation of all utility modes (--files, --type-list, --generate, --version, --pcre2-version)
Comprehensive coverage of all shell completion options (Bash, Zsh, Fish, PowerShell)
Excellent practical examples showing real-world usage patterns
Clear explanations of use cases for each utility mode
Correct documentation of --generate options: man, complete-bash, complete-zsh, complete-fish, complete-powershell
Accurate description of --files mode and its interaction with filters
Proper documentation of --type-list output format and custom type verification
Correct explanation of version flags (-V/--version) and --pcre2-version
Helpful integration examples with editors, CI/CD, and build scripts
Good troubleshooting section addressing common issues
improvement_suggestions: Could add note about --files overriding --type-list (documented in implementation but not explicitly called out in chapter)
Could mention that --version and -V have different output verbosity levels (--version is more verbose)
Could add example showing how --type-list respects --type-add and --type-clear flags (mentioned in doc_long but not demonstrated)
Could add note about --generate output going to stdout (mentioned in doc but could be more prominent in examples)

metadata.validation_focus: Ensure utility modes like --files, --type-list, --generate, --version are documented with usage examples
